name: Loot Magnet
description: The corpses of creatures killed near you are looted into your inventory a moment later. On the host or a dedicated server it works for every player, also those who joined without EMF; each switches their own with /loot.toggle. Never inside a base, never a player's or an ally's body, never a corpse twice.

settings.label: Reach (m)
settings.help: Corpses this close to a player come to them.

settings.label: After the kill (s)
settings.help: The loot comes no sooner than this after the death.

settings.label: Looks for loot for (s)
settings.help: After the kill. The game gives a corpse its loot 1-3 s after it dies; an older corpse is left to you.

settings.label: What comes

options.label: Corpses that hold only materials (and food)

settings.help: A corpse with gear in it is left for you to open.

settings.label: On for players who never switched it
settings.help: Each player switches their own with /loot.toggle (kept per world and account).

settings.label: Your key to switch it
settings.help: The host's own magnet; empty = no key (loot.toggle in the console works too).

settings.label: Never within (m) of a flame altar
settings.help: Nothing inside a base is looted.

settings.label: Log every decision
settings.help: A line in emf_core.log for each death noted and each corpse looted or left, with the reason.
